description: Erection of a hip to gable and rear roof extension with two front roof windows
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ST_SEP21_70 SWY_000 ST_SEP21_70 SWY_001,  ST_SEP21_70 SWY_002, ST_SEP21_70 SWY_003 , ST_SEP21_70 SWY_004,  ST_SEP21_70 SWY_005, ST_SEP21_70 SWY_006, ST_SEP21_70 SWY_007- Received 03/02/2022 Fire Safety Strategy Received 23/11/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
